stem: A fintech platform is deciding between DynamoDB pricing modes for two workloads: one has unpredictable spikes, the other has stable known throughput. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Use Amazon MQ broker instance classes to bill DynamoDB table capacity.
Use AWS App Runner service quotas to define DynamoDB RCU commitments.
Use AWS Backup Audit Manager controls to define DynamoDB throughput limits.
Use on-demand mode for the unpredictable workload to avoid idle capacity planning.
Use provisioned mode with auto scaling for the stable workload profile.

rationale: On-demand mode fits unpredictable spikes, while provisioned mode with auto scaling aligns with stable known throughput where tuning can reduce cost. MQ, App Runner, and Snowball controls are unrelated to DynamoDB table capacity billing modes.
